title: repo-analyst improvement decision
description: The tagged decision union returned by the improvement task. Declining to change anything is a first-class outcome: two of the three branches carry no candidate at all, so the run has an honest way to report that the evidence does not support a change.

oneOf.title: propose-change
oneOf.description: A generalized agent-behavior gap backed by cited evidence, with complete replacement source for one component.

target.description: Component the candidate replaces, such as agent.core.

generalized_failure.description: The reusable behavior gap, stated independently of any single run.

evidence.description: Run and source evidence that must exist in the captured providers. Unsupported claims fail evaluation even when the patch looks plausible.

resource.description: Run ID for history providers, or relative path for the workspace provider.

positions.description: Positive event sequence IDs for a run, or positive source line numbers for a workspace path.

candidate.description: Complete replacement source. Source is authoritative because it can be hashed and compiled exactly; a diff may accompany it for review but is not executable truth.

base_source_hash.description: Exact sha256-prefixed source_hash returned by runs/effective-preludes for the component this candidate replaces. Verified against the installed component before compilation.

evaluation_plan.description: Cases the proposer expects to be run. Held-out cases are chosen by the evaluator, not from this list.

oneOf.title: no-change
oneOf.description: The evidence is sufficient and shows no reusable agent-behavior gap. An isolated defect belongs in a normal bug report, not in a change to shared agent behavior.

rationale.description: Why the observed behavior is a one-off rather than a reusable gap.

evidence.description: The evidence that was examined before declining.

resource.description: Run ID for history providers, or relative path for the workspace provider.

positions.description: Positive event sequence IDs for a run, or positive source line numbers for a workspace path.

oneOf.title: insufficient-evidence
oneOf.description: The captured providers do not contain enough evidence to decide. This is not a failure of the run; it is the correct answer when the sources do not support a conclusion.

rationale.description: What was searched and why it was not conclusive.

missing_evidence.description: What would have to be captured to decide.
